response.sql:
WITH account_town AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    c.town_city
  FROM Accounts a
  INNER JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL
),
transaction_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    at.account_id,
    at.town_city,
    COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count
  FROM account_town at
  LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON at.account_id = ft.account_id
  GROUP BY at.account_id, at.town_city
),
window_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    town_city,
    transaction_count,
    SUM(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town_city) AS town_total,
    AVG(transaction_count) OVER () AS avg_count
  FROM transaction_counts
)
SELECT 
  account_id,
  town_city,
  transaction_count,
  CAST(transaction_count AS DECIMAL) / CAST(town_total AS DECIMAL) AS share_of_town,
  CAST(transaction_count AS DECIMAL) / CAST(avg_count AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_to_average
FROM window_stats
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC
LIMIT 10

alternatives.interpretation: The "average transaction count per account across these accounts" could be interpreted as the average within each town (per-town average), comparing each account to its town's mean rather than the global mean. The request says "across these accounts" without specifying "in the same town," but "these accounts" could theoretically refer back to the town-specific accounts mentioned in column 4.
